nodes.label: MVP Scope Boundary (65 MVP + 30 future, Appendix A)
nodes.norm_label: mvp scope boundary (65 mvp + 30 future, appendix a)

nodes.label: Phase-Scoped Execution Rule
nodes.rationale: Only execute the requested phase/step; do not jump phases, scaffold new projects, or overwrite files with templates.

nodes.label: README as Primary Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: readme as primary source of truth
nodes.rationale: Durable decisions live in the repo README, not chat/session memory; README read fully only at new chat/phase or on conflict to save effort; latest user decision overrides older product advice.

nodes.label: Secret Handling (no service_role in VITE_ vars, no PIN logging)
nodes.norm_label: secret handling (no service_role in vite_ vars, no pin logging)
nodes.rationale: Publishable key does not replace RLS.

nodes.label: Server-Side Enforcement (PIN check, attempt limit, expiry/revoke, RLS, safe column projection)
nodes.norm_label: server-side enforcement (pin check, attempt limit, expiry/revoke, rls, safe column projection)
nodes.rationale: Frontend flags and route guards are not a security boundary.

nodes.label: Shared Actions for Manual and Autoplay Demo
nodes.norm_label: shared actions for manual and autoplay demo
nodes.rationale: Linked guest/admin scenes share a store, distinct scenarios are isolated; deterministic reset and explicit timer/listener cleanup since remount alone is not cleanup.

nodes.label: Verification Policy (build/lint/tests, RLS with two client sessions + admin, browser UI check)
nodes.norm_label: verification policy (build/lint/tests, rls with two client sessions + admin, browser ui check)
nodes.rationale: Never claim success for builds/tests not run or nonexistent test commands.
